environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.11 and SQLite.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 80/443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
